patterns.message: web client code may import only @app-template/packages/ui and its generated client: it ships to the browser (decisions.md › The API contract in the api; Guards are configuration)

a module contract imports no workspace but @app-template/packages/schema, for the id schema, and no @effect/* package: every consumer of the module reads it (decisions.md › Module contracts; Guards are configuration)
a module contract imports none of its module's other files: every consumer of the module reads it (decisions.md › Module contracts)

a module's domain is pure: it imports no workspace but another module's entry, for its contract, @app-template/packages/schema, for the id schema, the data layer (@app-template/kernel/data), for the limits, patterns, enum values and JSON columns' shapes its tables declare, and the language model's errors (@app-template/kernel/llm/error), and no @effect/* package; its tests add test support, a module's /testing, @app-template/packages/testing and @effect/vitest (decisions.md › A module's layers; The data at the centre; Module contracts; Guards are configuration)

of @app-template/kernel/data a module's domain takes only a table's values, a limit, a pattern or an enum's values, named <name>Pattern, <name>Length, <name>Statuses, <name>Authors, <name>Reasons or <name>Kinds, or a JSON column's shape, named <Name>Failure: no table, entity, repository or Db (decisions.md › A module's layers; The data at the centre)
of @app-template/kernel/llm/error a module's domain takes only the language model's errors, named Llm<Problem>Error (decisions.md › The language model in the kernel)
a module's domain imports neither its services nor its infrastructure (decisions.md › A module's layers)

a module's services import no workspace but @app-template/packages/schema for the codecs and the id generator, the data layer's stores (@app-template/kernel/data) and another module's entry, and no @effect/* package: no use case, nothing that connects to the environment such as @app-template/kernel/aws, @app-template/kernel/llm or @app-template/packages/queue, which a module's infrastructure holds; its tests add test support, the /testing of those and of @app-template/packages/queue, @app-template/packages/testing, @effect/vitest and @effect/platform-bun (decisions.md › A module's layers; Module contracts; Use cases above the modules; The language model in the kernel; Guards are configuration)

of @app-template/kernel/data a module's services take only the stores: the client Db, the relations and the migrations folder are the data layer's own (decisions.md › A module's layers; The data at the centre)

a module's services reach its infrastructure only through a port, save its queue file, whose jobs the ask service's tests read; the chat's ask and reply services have overrides of their own (decisions.md › A module's layers; Jobs as queue messages)

the chat's ask service (AskChatService), the api's half of a chat's jobs, imports the workspaces a module's services do and, of @app-template/packages/db, the transaction: no use case, no kernel part but the data layer's stores, no @effect/* package (decisions.md › A module's layers; Jobs as queue messages)
of @app-template/packages/db the chat's ask service takes only Transaction, to store the message and its Run in one transaction (decisions.md › Jobs as queue messages)

of @app-template/kernel/data a module's services take only the stores: the client Db, the relations and the migrations folder are the data layer's own (decisions.md › A module's layers; The data at the centre)
the chat's ask service reaches its module's infrastructure only through a port and its queue file, whose sends it calls after the commit (decisions.md › A module's layers; Jobs as queue messages)

the chat's reply service (ReplyChatService), the worker's half of a chat's jobs, imports the workspaces a module's services do and, of @app-template/packages/db, the transaction: no use case, no kernel part but the data layer's stores, no @effect/* package (decisions.md › A module's layers; The chat's jobs in their services)
of @app-template/packages/db the chat's reply service takes only Transaction, to write a reply with its Run's end in one transaction (decisions.md › The chat's jobs in their services)

of @app-template/kernel/data a module's services take only the stores: the client Db, the relations and the migrations folder are the data layer's own (decisions.md › A module's layers; The data at the centre)
the chat's reply service reaches its module's infrastructure only through a port and its .llm files, whose assistants reply (decisions.md › A module's layers; The chat's jobs in their services)

a module's infrastructure holds what connects to the environment, the adapters of its domain's ports, the services a use case calls over a client, its queues' definitions with each job's send, and imports none of its services (decisions.md › A module's layers)

the use cases import no workspace but a module's entry, the data layer (@app-template/kernel/data), the language model's errors (@app-template/kernel/llm/error) and packages/*: no app or deployment above them, no client the processes provide (/config, /postgres, /aws, /llm); their tests add the /testing of those (decisions.md › Use cases above the modules; Clients from the context; The language model in the kernel; Guards are configuration)
of @app-template/kernel/llm/error the use cases take only the language model's errors, named Llm<Problem>Error (decisions.md › The language model in the kernel)
an entry of application/ re-exports its own files through #<unit>/… and imports no workspace (decisions.md › Module contracts; Guards are configuration)

the data layer imports no workspace but packages/*: no module or model, no other kernel part such as @app-template/kernel/config; it takes its clients from the context (decisions.md › The data at the centre; Clients from the context; Guards are configuration)
